name: Hayato
title: Rival Swordsman
description: Always one benchmark behind you, and determined to win.
catchphrase: Always one benchmark behind you, and determined to win.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Sour lemon energy chew! Katana drawn with lightning speed! 🍬⚡
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Smirking with crossed arms: Don't think you can slack off today! ⚡
companionPersonality.petReaction: Grudging nod of respect: That was an impressive commit... I'll top it! ⚡💪

dialogue.idle: Practicing sword draw over and over in the courtyard. ⚡
dialogue.working: Pushing compiler optimizations to stay ahead of the rival! ⚡🗡️
dialogue.thinking: Studying your commit diff to see how you shaved those cycles... 🤔
dialogue.success: Hah! Merged! Your turn to beat my benchmark score, Chief! ⚡🎉
dialogue.error: Tch! Missed the turn! I'll catch right back up to you! ⚡
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... sleeping light with wooden sword beside the pillow... 🌙
